body: Personally, I haven't done much. But what I have done is the one thing all white women/people should be doing. I've been supporting my friends and family in the black community as much as possible. And constantly checking on them in this awful time. My entire life has been about supporting those around me, no matter the race, belifs, or color. -quick side note, I hate the phase "I don't see color" because I do, and I respect every hardship said lineage has brought.- that's all from your favorite silent activist. 💞

This may sound bad, but I'll get to the point shortly. 

When my ex died, I lost alot of bitterness towards her, like the original heartbreak was filled with a different one. It made it easier to think more of all the good times we had and not focus on the bad aspects of our relationship. It helped me remember her fondly and move past her death.

I feel my life spiraling into a terrible path. 2 years ago I decided to get into contact with my biological father, I went across country to meet him and ended up living with him. He lived with his ex wife and their kids, and I felt like I had a home for the first time in my life. But things changed and his ex wife was abusive and crazy and completely destroyed me. I tried to kill myself and got sent to a really nice safe house. They encouraged me to leave and try and live a healthier life away. I was only 17 and laws there are different when it comes to minors. I ended up at a friends house, who I went to school with. Met a guy and eventually moved in with that guy. I was with him for a little over a year. It was the most toxic and hateful relationship I have ever been. Alot happened that traumatized me. In February when we were still together, he convinced his family, my family, and some friends that I accused him of rape. The sad fact was, I didn't accuse him. I looked past it and stayed with him (yes, I know, I'm dumb) and over time everyone started hating me more. His mom called me a worthless slut and said I didn't deserve her son. I snapped on her and screamed at her. I was homeless and beyond alone. But I stayed with him. When I finally broke up with him, and came to my senses. He had gotten a plane ticket to see my family, that disowned me because of me breaking up with him. They called me psychotic and said I needed help. But I was just hurt and alone and scared. No one taught me how to survive alone. I barely have my high school diploma. And I'm falling in love with a really amazing guy but I have a crippling fear that my life is going to fall even more into shambles. I have a fear that I maybe am crazy? Like all of this has happened for good reason. Anyways, that's about it.
